metadata.title: GestandoApp — your pregnancy, week by week
metadata.description: The pregnancy journal that keeps up with you every week: progress, doctor appointments, and how you're feeling, all in one place. Join the waitlist for launch.

features.heading: Everything you need to go through your pregnancy

progress.title: Track your progress, week by week
progress.body: Your baby's size, how many days are left until your due date, and how your body is changing — all in one place.

agenda.title: Your medical schedule, no surprises
agenda.body: Checkups, ultrasounds, and lab work with date, time, and clinic. Confirm each appointment and get a reminder before it arrives.

diary.title: A journal for every day
diary.body: Log how you felt, your symptoms, and photos along the way. Over time, it becomes the sweetest record of your pregnancy.

cta.heading: Join the waitlist
cta.subtitle: We're polishing the last details. Leave your email and be one of the first to use it.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.draftNotice: This is a technical draft written from the data the app actually collects. It has not been reviewed by a lawyer and is not legal advice.
privacy.intro: GestandoApp ("we") is an app for tracking pregnancy. This policy explains what data we collect, what we use it for, who we share it with, and what rights you have over it.

applicableLaw.heading: Applicable law
applicableLaw.body: This policy is written to align with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), which applies if you use the app from an EU country, and with Law No. 787, Nicaragua's Personal Data Protection Law, the country where the data controller is based. [To verify with legal counsel in Nicaragua: there isn't enough up-to-date public documentation on how this law is applied in practice to write this section with full confidence.]

controller.heading: 1. Data controller
body: GestandoApp is operated by Juan Ramón Junior Romero Cano, as an individual, based in Managua, Nicaragua, who is the controller of your personal data.
For any privacy question, you can reach us at contact@jromeroc.dev.

dataCollected.heading: 2. What data we collect
dataCollected.intro: We collect the data you enter directly into the app:

categories.title: Account
items: Email and password (your password is stored encrypted, never in plain text)
First name, last name, height, and pre-pregnancy weight

categories.title: Pregnancy
items: Last menstrual period, due date, baby's name, notes, medical conditions (e.g. anemia, gestational diabetes, hypertension), your doctor and clinic's details

categories.title: Appointments
items: Date, location, and provider for each appointment
Vitals you log: blood pressure, uterine height, fetal heart rate, estimated baby weight
Reports or results you upload

categories.title: Diary
items: Mood, symptoms, weight, baby movements, sleep hours
Photos and voice notes you add
Free-text notes you write

categories.title: Progress
items: Pregnancy progress photos, weight, and belly circumference by week

dataCollected.note: This is health data. We treat it as a special category of data and only process it with your explicit consent.

purpose.heading: 3. What we use your data for
items: To provide the service: showing your progress, appointments, and journal
To send you the reminders you set up yourself (appointments, weigh-ins, journal notes)
To provide support when you contact us
To improve the app in aggregate, anonymized form
purpose.legalBasis: The legal basis for processing your health data is your explicit consent, given when you create your account. You can withdraw it at any time by deleting your account.

sharing.heading: 4. Who we share your data with
body: We don't sell your data or use it for advertising.

We use Supabase (database and file storage) as a data processor to run the app. Your data is hosted in the US East (Ohio) region. Supabase incorporates the EU Standard Contractual Clauses into its Data Processing Addendum to cover this international data transfer if you're a user in the European Union. [To confirm: that the Data Processing Addendum with Supabase is actually accepted on the project account.]
We may share data if required to by law.

retention.heading: 5. How long we keep your data
retention.body: We keep your data while your account is active. If you delete your account, we delete your personal data within a reasonable period, unless the law requires us to retain some information for longer.

rights.heading: 6. Your rights
rights.intro: Regardless of which country you use the app from, you have the right to:
items: Access the data we hold about you
Correct inaccurate or incomplete data (rectification)
Ask us to delete your account and your data ("right to be forgotten" / cancellation)
Request a copy of your data in a portable format
Object to processing or withdraw your consent at any time
Lodge a complaint with your country's data protection authority
rights.note: These rights match those granted by the GDPR to users in the European Union, and the access, rectification, cancellation, and objection rights under Nicaragua's Law No. 787.
rights.how: You can delete your own account at any time from Profile → Danger zone in the app, or exercise any of these rights by writing to us at contact@jromeroc.dev.

security.heading: 7. Security
security.body: We apply reasonable technical measures to protect your data, such as password encryption and secure connections (HTTPS). No app is 100% secure, but we're committed to improving these measures over time.

children.heading: 8. Children
children.body: GestandoApp is not directed at minors.

changes.heading: 9. Changes to this policy
changes.body: If we make material changes to this policy, we'll notify you in the app before they take effect.
